title: A component of the VIABLE harness
description: What another team's work (or VIABLE's own) does in the loop, what learner data it receives, where it sends it, its license and citation, and its evidence in three parts. docs/components.md explains each field.

version.description: the component's own version; agents pin it

kind.description: core: JavaScript in this repository; mcp or http: out of process

entry.description: core: the export that runs it, such as checkReply; mcp: the tool's name; http: the endpoint's URL, which the harness POSTs JSON to

server.description: mcp: the command and arguments that start its stdio MCP server, run without a shell

step_type.description: the graph step type that runs it, when one does

receives.description: the only learner data passed to it; never a learner's name or identifier beyond the pseudonymous id learning events carry

sends_to.description: every host it contacts itself, besides the host's own model endpoint

uses_models.description: whether it calls models: in process through the host's model service, out of process on its own (its model's host then in sends_to)

attribution.description: carried into every package that uses it

original.description: what its authors showed, and for whom

integration.description: what comparisons with and without it in the harness showed, with the runs

unknown.description: what nobody has shown yet, such as effects on learning

harness.description: harness versions its fixtures pass on, as a semver range

fixtures.description: where its inputs and expected outputs are, for the conformance run
